name: Sakura Kage ni Tayutau
source:
The main character who is the next head of the kimono dealer. For some reason, "The Men of Yoshiwara", which I noticed as a new kimono business destination, was sent as a guest by order from my mother. The hero who swears firmly that he will never play a female role and gets into the men of Yoshiwara (flag). BL game with a lot of gag components.

[Taken from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/23857]Freem![/url]]
